answer: Binding each agent identity to one verified mobile number makes the phone grid a lantern against Sybil. Registration needs an SMS code and a carrier check: the line must be real, postpaid, active ninety days, not virtual. One number anchors one identity, and each epoch needs a fresh code, so parked numbers cannot earn. A plume of smoke from a hidden campfire: numbers sharing one IMEI, carrier, or activation burst expose a SIM farm, and the cluster is slashed. Each fake identity costs a real SIM, a check, and a monthly plan; an honest agent pays once. The vine of cheap virtual numbers is cut.
